title: roll.toml
description: roll apps' [app] in roll.toml (docs/apps/README.md). Other sections are roll code's and roll up --all's; they're left open here.

run.description: Run settings, as the API's run (not volume: that's the service's).

type.description: What it runs: a web service, a worker, or a cron job.

port.description: The port the app listens on (PORT is set to it; default 8080).

pre_deploy.description: Runs once before each deployment goes live (a migration); a failure stops the deploy.

timezone.description: The schedule's time zone (IANA, e.g. Europe/Budapest; default UTC).

timeout_s.description: A cron run's or a job's time limit, seconds.

retries.description: A failed cron run's retries (backoff doubling).

min_instances.description: Instances kept up (0: sleeps when idle).

max_instances.description: The most instances it scales to.

concurrency.description: Requests an instance takes at once before another starts.

health_path.description: A path that answers 2xx or 3xx when the app is ready (starts with /).

health_timeout_s.description: How long a new instance may take to become healthy, seconds.

suspend_after_s.description: Idle seconds before an instance is frozen (wakes in milliseconds).

sleep_after_s.description: Idle seconds before an instance is stopped.

alerts.description: Alert thresholds (memory_pct, error_pct, p95_ms, log_match, log_count).

rollout.description: A gradual rollout: steps (percents), step_s, error_pct.

h2c.description: The app speaks HTTP/2 without TLS (gRPC).

scale.description: Scale a worker on a stream's lag: stream, group, per_instance.

public.description: Answers on its public address (false: only on the private network).

drain_s.description: Seconds an old instance keeps serving in-flight requests after a switch.

cpu_target.description: Scale out above this CPU percent.

restart.description: When a worker that exits is started again.

affinity.description: Send a client back to the same instance (a cookie).

rollback_on_crash.description: Roll back when a new deployment crash-loops.

builder.description: auto: detect; dockerfile: build the tree's own Dockerfile.

dockerfile.description: The Dockerfile's path in the tree (builder = "dockerfile").

pre_deploy.description: Runs once before each deployment goes live (a migration).

health_path.description: A path that answers 2xx or 3xx when the app is ready (starts with /).

watch.description: Path patterns a push must touch to deploy.

spa.description: A single-page app: unknown paths answer index.html.

packages.description: System packages the generated Dockerfile installs (apt, or apk on Alpine): ffmpeg, chromium, libvips42.

app.description: A service's build and deploy settings, applied at each build over the service's own.

environments.description: Per environment (by name), the same settings again, applied last.

previews.description: Preview environments, the same settings again (before an environment's block), and roll previews' screenshots.

screenshots.description: What roll previews' screenshots do, as roll.toml's [preview] takes them: pages, hide and [[states]] (name, page, steps). Checked by roll previews.
